content: chat.db's attributedBody column is an NSMutableAttributedString serialized in Apple's 'typedstream' format (used by NSArchiver/NSUnarchiver), not JSON or protobuf; python-typedstream (dgelessus) is the maintained pure-Python decoder. Confirms this repo's approach (already solved per CLAUDE.md) is the correct one -- text is not directly present as UTF-8 and must go through a typedstream reader, historically Ventura+ where the plain-text  column started coming back empty for richer messages.
